sites.name: Global headquarters, One Dell Way
sites.description: Principal executive offices and global headquarters

source.label: Dell Technologies Form 10-K for fiscal year ended January 31, 2025, Item 2 Properties
source.quote: Our principal executive offices and global headquarters are located at One Dell Way, Round Rock, Texas.

notes: Dell publishes no state, country or regional breakdown of employees, sites, investment or taxes for FY2025. The 10-K gives approximately 108,000 employees (no geography). Item 2 gives floor space only as U.S. facilities (7.2 million sq ft owned, 1.0 leased) and international facilities (4.2 owned, 5.9 leased), as of Jan 31, 2025; square footage has no unit in this lens, so it is recorded here and not as rows. Owned manufacturing facilities are named only by country, not city ('We own manufacturing facilities located in the United States, Malaysia, China, Brazil, India, Poland, and Ireland'), so they are not listed as sites. Checked the FY2025 10-K and the FY25 'Impact by the Numbers' brief (delltechnologies.com), which has no geographic workforce data; a search of Dell's ESG report listings found no FY25 report with headcount by country or region.
